verdict.rationale: CRA's only programmatic channel in evidence is EFILE/ReFILE, where certified tax software and enrolled electronic filers transmit returns system-to-system. That is a real first-party machine interface, but it is gated behind software certification and filer enrollment and covers only return transmission. Registration, payments, account management and enquiries are described solely as web portal or form workflows, and there is no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs index (cra-probe-2 shows a soft 404). Missing for 10: a publicly documented, openly accessible API with published specs, coverage beyond return filing, self-serve credentials for individual users or agents, and agent-oriented documentation.
